games.name: Exit Only
games.tagline: Outsmart the police. Lose the helicopter. Get out.
games.description: A police pursuit through a rainy night city that changes every run: its hour, weather and traffic, and the streets shut for roadworks or a night market. The police only know where you are when someone can see you: break every line of sight around corners, through traffic and under the Plaza Tunnel, fight back with nitro, oil, spikes and smoke, and stay hidden from the helicopter's searchlight until they give up. Every crash leaves its mark on your car and theirs. Also includes Rooftop Rush, a real-time sliding-vehicle puzzle on a gridlocked parking deck.
features: A different night city every run: closures, weather and traffic
Police that chase, cut you off, ram you and run dark, over six wanted levels
A helicopter that hunts with a real searchlight
Crash damage you can see on every car
Gadgets: nitro, oil, spikes and smoke
Real driving: gears, grip and drifts
